name: Aggressive Ball Hunter
description: Chases the ball relentlessly, prioritizing ball possession and direct advance toward the red goal. Uses high-speed forward moves to reach the ball quickly, applies pressure on defenders, and looks for clear shooting opportunities or to create space for a shot.

name: Smart Space Creator
description: Maintains strategic positioning to create passing lanes and overloads on one flank. Stays between the ball and opponents to open space for the teammate, enabling implicit coordination without explicit communication.

name: Defensive Stalwart
description: Positioned to shield the goal, prioritizes interception and clearance when the red team threatens. Drops back to block threats and then supports ball transition to midfield, keeping the goal area protected.

name: Balanced Team Player
description: Performs a safe, adaptable role in the midfield, supporting the teammate and ball flow. Keeps a flexible distance, reacts to ball position, and avoids unnecessary risks while maintaining option-rich positioning.

name: Unselfish Opportunist
description: Looks for off-ball runs to draw defenders away and create space behind the line. Ready to capitalize on teammate-led plays, keeping pressure while prioritizing team-created opportunities over solo glory.
